snippet.title: [FULL DEMO GAMEPLAY] That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes... Survival Fantasy VN
snippet.description:
That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes and Now I'm Bound to a Multiverse Protector! is a browser-based survival horror / psychological visual novel built entirely in vanilla JavaScript.

The story begins inside a school suddenly attacked by giant dimensional snakes, but slowly evolves into a darker psychological mystery involving parallel worlds, hidden truths, and reality distortion.

This project was also a programming challenge for me since I built the VN engine from scratch without frameworks. The game includes:

* Hidden long-term choice systems
* Branching dialogue and routes
* Custom save/state handling
* Layered visual transitions
* Browser-first instant play

One of the main mechanics is a hidden “Resolve” system where small decisions quietly affect later survival outcomes. I intentionally avoided visible morality meters so choices feel more uncertain and natural.

The current public build contains the first 10 chapters.

Play here:
https://hudarashi.itch.io/vn-dimensional-snakes

Would love feedback on:

* pacing
* narrative structure
* hidden choice systems
* browser performance
* overall atmosphere
